purpose: Observation metadata for original geometry reconstruction of Second Avenue E7–E12; no photograph assets licensed for distribution

coverage.primary_area: East side of Second Avenue between East 7th and East 12th Streets

important_modeling_notes: Photographs are individually observed, not generic facade recipes.
Historic survey signs are separated from tenant checks. A 2026 setting needs additional current frontage photos for unverified storefronts.
Swiss Institute has closed at 130 Second Avenue/38 St Marks; do not label it currently open.
STOMP sign is historic. Retain the distinctive Orpheum architecture independently of production branding.
West-side landmarks fall beyond the stated ten-block footprint but face its western boundary.
Window counts refer to architectural opening groups; paired panes are described separately. Null means insufficient photographic confidence, not zero.
No downloaded observation image should be committed to Site assets or redistributed.
